Pencil Sketch Effect

Turn any photo into a hand-drawn pencil sketch with a real color-dodge algorithm.

✏️ Drop an image here or click to browse

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an image into the tool.
  2. The pencil sketch appears instantly.
  3. Click Download PNG to save it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the sketch computed?

Grayscale, then invert, blur, and a pixel-level color-dodge blend — the same technique photo editors use.

Which photos work best?

Photos with strong outlines and good contrast — portraits and buildings work best.

What format is the download?

A lossless PNG at the original dimensions.
